data.cultural_impact: The name Marilee gained popularity in the English-speaking world due to its association with the Virgin Mary, who is a significant cultural figure in Christianity. data.spiritual_significance: The name Marilee, being derived from the name Maria, carries a deep spiritual significance for Christians. The name Maria is a symbol of Mary, the Mother of God, and the name Marilee serves as a reminder of her rebelliousness and obedience to God's will. In the Christian perspective, the name Marilee can be seen as a representation of the paradoxical nature of Mary, who was both unwilling to conform to societal expectations (rebellious) and yet fully obedient to God's plan for her life (obedient). This duality makes Marilee a powerful name with spiritual depth and meaning for Christians.
